failure_reason: First-block encountered: https://www.potterybarnkids.com/shop/bedding/ returned a full-page '403 - Restricted Access' (site's own WAF block page) partway through the research pass, immediately after the Storage branch had been fully captured. Per the browser-only hard rules, all further requests to the potterybarnkids.com host were stopped at that point (no retry/chase via another route). This happened before any Bedding/Bath/Rugs/Windows/Decor subcategory URL or quantity (the Textile-candidate branches) could be captured, so textile_rows is empty rather than guessed or fabricated.
notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.potterybarnkids.com/robots.txt) has no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot disallow - only EasouSpider is fully blocked and Pinterestbot has a crawl-delay; User-agent:* disallows only account/checkout/search/tracking-type paths, so proceeded. Site is on the Williams-Sonoma platform (shares nav chrome with Pottery Barn, PB Teen, RH, West Elm). TREE METHOD: opened own Chrome tab, read the top mega-menu (Baby, Furniture, Bedding, Decor, Lighting, Bath, Rugs, Windows, Toys & Play, Baby Gear, Gifts, Halloween, Study, Backpacks & Lunch, Sale). Furniture menu exposed a 'Storage Furniture' link (/shop/storage/all-storage-furniture-acc/) which is the site's own dedicated Storage section; its own sub-nav strip (read via DOM extraction, not View-All) listed 8 real subcategories: Wall Systems, Bookcases, Bins & Baskets, Shelving, Storage Beds, Desks, Toy Storage, Nursery Storage. 'Shop All Storage', 'All Storage Furniture', 'All Storage Accessories' were View-All/aggregate links and excluded per rule; 'Playroom'/'Family Spaces'/'Bedroom' were shop-by-room cross-links to the same underlying facets and were also excluded to avoid duplicate rows. QTY METHOD: each of the 8 subcategory pages is a client-side-rendered facet listing (URL segment like producttype-m-product-type-...); the total is NOT in a static h1 but renders asynchronously as 'N Items' text in the filter bar. Product grid + count text loads on a delay (page loads with 0 products / a false 'no products in your location' message on first read even though country=USA), so each page was read only after an explicit wait, and pages that still showed 0/empty were re-read once more with a longer wait before the real count appeared - none were retried more than that, and no zero was ever recorded as a final qty. Evidence string = the exact 'N Items' text captured from the page body after render. EXCLUDED: Storage Beds (bunk/loft/captain's/upholstered beds with storage) and Desks (writing desks/hutches) are furniture-storage hybrids per storage.md 21; site explicitly places them under the Storage nav section (not under generic Bedroom/Study Furniture), so per storage.md 21's 'explicit site categorization wins' rule they were kept in storage_rows but flagged confidence MEDIUM rather than HIGH. Bookcases and Shelving are similarly flagged MEDIUM per storage.md 18's explicit ambiguity callout, again explicit-site-placement wins for inclusion. BLOCKED: attempting the next branch (/shop/bedding/) returned a hard 403 'Restricted Access' page (confirmed via get_page_text, title 'Pottery Barn Kids: 403 - Restricted Access'); per the standing rule this stopped all further potterybarnkids.com requests immediately - Bath, Rugs, Windows, and Decor (all likely Textile-bearing branches: towels/bath mats/robes, area rugs, curtains, throws) were never opened and are not represented in textile_rows because no real qty/URL evidence exists for them. No View All/Collection/search/product-detail URLs were recorded. No quantities were estimated, aggregated, or carried over between pages.
